_what: C-FIX-1 Part 4 (2 Oct 2026, Emil R43 / §20): the only files besides the OpenClaw door that may open a network connection. Read by test/test_only_openclaw_reaches_the_web.py.

_classes.M: a local model or a cloud model backend
_classes.O: an outbound channel: the Telegram alarm or GitHub publication
_classes.L: loopback only: nothing leaves the machine

_hosts: every host a file names in a URL; a host not listed here fails the test

agents/body/body_scanner.py.reason: TCP reachability of the local OpenClaw gateway (127.0.0.1:18789); no outside host

cockpit/terminal.py.reason: the cockpit's own websocket server on the loopback address; nothing leaves the machine

core/aggressive_cleanup.py.reason: unloads models from the local Ollama model on localhost:11434

core/brain.py.reason: the local brain: local Ollama model on localhost:11434

core/local_llm.py.reason: the local model on localhost:11434 - the only language model (C-CLOUD-1, R45)

core/knowledge.py.reason: embeddings from the local Ollama model on localhost:11434; www.youtube.com is only a stored link, never fetched

core/llm_door.py.reason: the one door every model call goes through (local and cloud)

experiments/institution/telegram_dispatc.reason: Telegram: the alarm/approval channel to Emil

experiments/institution/telegram_witness.reason: Telegram: the alarm/approval channel to Emil

experiments/institution/witness_reader.p.reason: Telegram: reads Emil's replies on the alarm/approval channel

experiments/needs/approve_reader.py.reason: Telegram: reads Emil's approvals on the alarm channel

experiments/needs/needs_report.py.reason: Telegram alarm; ntfy.sh is an alternative carrier of the same alarm chosen in memory/notify_channel.json

experiments/needs/setup_telegram.py.reason: Telegram: one-time setup of the alarm channel, run by hand

experiments/pulse/pulse_continuum.py.reason: checks that the local Ollama port 11434 is open; loopback only

experiments/pulse/pulse_daemon.py.reason: TCP reachability of the local OpenClaw gateway (127.0.0.1:18789); loopback only

fast_cycle_runner.py.reason: dependency check: lists the local Ollama models (localhost)

memory/body_scan.py.reason: the body scan's local checks (Ollama on localhost); no outside model is pinged

scripts/devtools_line.py.reason: the door's direct line: one WebSocket to the DevTools port of the Chrome OpenClaw starts, on 127.0.0.1 only
scripts/devtools_line.py.question: A direct connection to OpenClaw's own Chrome, inside the machine, opens a page in 0.13-0.28 s instead of 15 s; pages are still opened by OpenClaw's browser, OpenClaw still starts and stops it; one new file enters the exception list of the guard test, for a connection inside the machine only.

supervisor.py.reason: Telegram: the supervisor's alarm to Emil

tools/morning_digest.py.reason: GitHub: reads the watched repo's commits through the publication channel's API

tools/sandbox/ollama_proxy.py.reason: a loopback proxy in front of the local Ollama; loopback only
